messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#84732 inference-proxy: high request spike detected in us-west-2 canary cluster. severity: page. link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/84732

sam: acked (sam). pulling graphs now :eyes:

maya: @sam do we have any customer-facing errors?

sam: initial glance: 20s spike in requests, p95 latency held, 5xx stayed flat. looks like synthetic canary or short burst from health-check farm. sending quick grafana snapshot

sam: ```
window=60s, metric=proxy.requests_per_sec
us-west-2: 120 -> 950 -> 130 RPS over 90s
p95 latency: 32ms -> 38ms -> 33ms
5xx: 0.02% -> 0.05% -> 0.01%
```

liam: noted. that shape screams synthetic canary flood (warmup loop) rather than customer traffic. any routing anomalies?

sam: checking router logs now, grabbing a tail from one host

sam: ```
$ kubectl -n inference logs router-5f6b7 -c proxy | tail -n 40
2026-03-15T18:03:22Z INFO req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=200 latency=28ms
2026-03-15T18:03:23Z INFO req_id=abc124 path=/v1/generate status=200 latency=31ms
2026-03-15T18:03:24Z INFO req_id=abc125 path=/v1/health status=200 latency=3ms
2026-03-15T18:03:40Z INFO req_id=abc300 path=/v1/generate status=200 latency=45ms
```

maya: @sam nice. so no elevated 5xx, latency fine. any PD escalations?

opsbot: Auto-silence applied: PD#84732 muted by alert-suppression for 3m because metric returned below firing threshold and noise detection flagged transient spike. (rule: suppress-if-duration<90s)

sam: thanks @opsbot. I think this was a canary loop re-triggering after a deploy of their harness. low customer impact. i'll keep monitoring for 10m then clear.

liam: +1. can we tighten the firing rule to require 60s sustained so flakes don't page? create follow-up ticket if so.

maya: agree — file a ticket and add owner. low risk change but reduces noise. @sam can you handle the ticket?

sam: will do. creating quick ticket: https://tasks.example/RED-5043 — "reduce proxy canary spike noisy pages: require 60s sustained". assigning to eng-sre.

sam: handoff: i'm on for next 8m then @maya take if it comes back.

maya: copy. monitoring from my side.

opsbot: Alert status update: PD#84732 resolved (auto-resolved). No customer incidents linked.

sam: closing thread after 10m quiet. no impact observed. filing root-cause note in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

liam: thanks team, good catch and quick suppress. we'll follow up on the tuning in RED-5043.

incident-bot: Thread closed (8332101234)."
